budget.cost_pilot: one child per model at W=256, L=768, max_updates 200, to measure seconds per update and per cell

criteria.context_need: the smallest W (by learning curve over W) at which the criterion is met; reported with W/P and the actual consumed span (W-1)/P and the effective receptive field
criteria.data_sufficiency: learning curve over training length: SATURATED when the best two lengths differ by < 5 % of MAE_baseline, UNSATURATED otherwise; declared honestly, never assumed
criteria.diagnostics: each cell is classified FITTED / UNDERFIT / OVERFIT / OPTIMIZATION_FAILURE from its curves and observed updates (rules in df_adequacy_models.diagnose)
criteria.raw_task_adequacy: skill = 1 - MAE_model / MAE_baseline on the final test; a clean task is ADEQUATE when skill >= 0.5 at some context, INADEQUATE when no context reaches 0.1; observed_increment is judged against the oracle floor: ADEQUATE when MAE_model <= 1.1 * MAE_oracle at some context
criteria.stopping: fixed factorial; no cell is added, repeated or re-seeded after seeing results; incomplete cells are reported

execution: NONE here; df_adequacy_run executes it governed under the budget
horizon_semantics: one-step direct; one-period and multi-period tasks are a separate staged proposal

causal_conv1d.dilations: 1,2,4,... until the receptive field covers W
causal_conv1d.head: last position -> Dense(1)
causal_conv1d.note: explicit multilayer causal Conv1D; receptive field computed from kernel/dilation and recorded

lstm.head: Dense(1) on the final state
lstm.note: state never carries across windows, so validation/test never leak into training state

ridge.note: closed form on train-only standardised features; the historical probe, kept as baseline

preserved: utildev-v1 (18 non-advances, 18 inconclusive) and utilinst-v1 stay at their original scope

questions.a_raw_task: can the learner predict the raw task?
questions.b_context: how much history does it need?

review_table.evidence: tasks and criteria sealed in this design; utildev-v1 kept at its original scope
review_table.executable_check: distinct questions: raw skill (this pilot), representation utility (utildev-v1, relative), denoising, forecasting/RL/policy utility (not tested); decision supported: whether ridge/W=4 was an adequate probe and what context/model the raw task needs

review_table.evidence: tests: label identity, recurrence oracle, noise-only control; per-cell oracle floor
review_table.executable_check: clean vs observed targets with exact row/horizon identity, irreducible future noise, meaningful baseline and a truth-derived oracle per task

review_table.evidence: per cell: W, (W-1)/P, RF, state policy; every model of a cell reads the same rows and labels
review_table.executable_check: time span, periods, lookback, emission time, receptive field/state, equal information across arms

review_table.evidence: learning curves over L in {256, 512, 768} and W (1024 needs a longer series: staged proposal); two independent units; regimes: one SNR, one perturbation (limited)
review_table.executable_check: usable training/evaluation rows after purge, independent series, regime coverage, learning curves

review_table.evidence: per cell: layers, parameters, RF, observed updates, curves, diagnosis; tests: updates observed, reload parity
review_table.executable_check: actual graph, optimizer updates, train/validation curves, capacity and context ablations, underfit vs overfit vs optimisation failure

review_table.evidence: tests: train-only scaling, forward held-out, future perturbation, restart parity; purge = W + h between splits
review_table.executable_check: train-only fitting and scaling, chronological nested validation, label-overlap purge, prefix/future/missingness/restart tests on the deployed path

review_table.evidence: same rows/labels per cell across models; contexts vary span explicitly; no tuning allowance
review_table.executable_check: raw skill first; matched decision times and targets; information span vs input width, capacity, compute and tuning allowance

review_table.evidence: skill with block-wise dispersion over the test; fixed factorial; no calibration transferred from ridge/W=4
review_table.executable_check: practical effect, uncertainty, multiplicity, replication, calibration scope, predefined stopping

review_table.evidence: not part of this pilot; protocol designed in 12E (S4)
review_table.executable_check: forecasting and RL tracked separately; weekly cutoff, release, costs, next-week evaluation

review_table.evidence: df_adequacy_verify recomputes every loss from arrays and compares with terminal/warehouse content
review_table.executable_check: losses recomputed from predictions and labels, rows linked to governed inputs, content reconciled, negative tests per guarantee, fresh vs retained queries labelled

clean_increment.denominator: MAE of the zero-change baseline on the same test rows
clean_increment.label: clean[t+1] - clean[t]

clean_next_level.denominator: MAE of the persistence baseline on the same test rows
clean_next_level.label: clean[t+1]
clean_next_level.oracle: analytic recurrence with the KNOWN period: 2cos(2pi/P)*clean[t] - clean[t-1] (diagnostic; truth-derived)

observed_increment.denominator: MAE of the zero-change baseline on the same test rows
observed_increment.label: observed[t+1] - observed[t]
observed_increment.limitation: the future noise sample is independent of the past: zero error is impossible; adequacy is judged against the oracle floor, never against zero
observed_increment.oracle: clean recurrence increment evaluated against the OBSERVED label: its error is the irreducible future-noise floor plus the noise already in the last observation (diagnostic)

training.scaling: input and label standardised with TRAIN-ONLY mean and sd per cell
training.tuning_allowance: NONE: no hyperparameter is changed after seeing a result
